name: The Startup Building
description: A historic former candy factory (built 1898) in downtown Provo with original brick walls, wooden beams and elevated ceilings in a rustic-industrial style. Includes a catering space, powder room and integrated sound; holds 120 seated or 300 standing, with an add-on outdoor courtyard.
priceText: Rates page $1,550–$2,750; comparison page $1,350–$2,500 (July 2026) (range spans both pages)

items.label: Description
items.value: A historic former candy factory (built 1898) in downtown Provo with original brick walls, wooden beams and elevated ceilings in a rustic-industrial style. Includes a catering space, powder room and integrated sound; holds 120 seated or 300 standing, with an add-on outdoor courtyard.

items.label: Price
items.value: Rates page $1,550–$2,750; comparison page $1,350–$2,500 (July 2026) (range spans both pages)

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
Full-day rental 10am-11pm with cafe lights, cake table, wooden arch, 2 wooden floor easels, 4 plastic cocktail tables, 150 wooden chairs, 15 wooden tables, 4 ADA restrooms, sound system with 2 wireless mics, digital projector with HDMI and AppleTV, catering area with fridge and freezer, 3 chandeliers with faux greenery, powder room — Mon-Wed — $1,550
Same inclusions — Thu — $2,250
Same inclusions — Fri & Sun — $2,550
Same inclusions — Sat — $2,750
Courtyard add-on — $500 Apr-Sep or $200 Oct-Mar
Alcohol fee with licensed bartender — $200

items.label: Deposit
items.value: Deposit required to reserve the date

items.label: Courtyard (add-on)
items.value: Setting: outdoor · Note: adds capacity; food trucks, photo bus or live band

items.label: Rooms
items.value: Bridal / get-ready room (powder room with mirrors, sink and couch)

items.label: Event coordinator
items.value: Manager reviews day-of details, then on call during the event

Powder room with mirrors, sink and couch

items.label: Catering
items.value:
Catering prep area with refrigerator and freezer
Outside vendors allowed; preferred caterer list provided

items.label: Kitchen / prep
items.value: Catering area with fridge and freezer

items.value:
Alcohol allowed with a licensed bartender
$200 alcohol fee

items.label: Restrictions
items.value:
No glitter
No confetti
No nails or tacks in walls or posts
Candles only in a votive

items.label: Parking
items.value:
South lot: 31 spaces
West lot: 16 spaces
Street parking on 100 W
Lot busy on weekdays until about 5pm

items.label: Notes
items.value:
Weekends typically book 1-2 months ahead; weekdays 2-4 weeks
Building also houses offices, so the lot is busier on weekdays before 5pm
Sister venue: The Bright Building
